context: The PulseVoice desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux (a business softphone that stays in the system tray so inbound calls keep arriving). These are the few words of the app's own shell: the tray menu and the dialog that offers to restart to install an update. Short, plain, polite. The program inserts {{placeholders}} (a version number) and they must be kept exactly as written, character for character; never translate what is inside {{ }}. 'Pulse' and 'PulseVoice' are product names and are never translated. Use the formal form of address where the language has one.
